title: What Will Remain at the End? (Easy Version)
statement: An array of n cells, each holding -1, 0, or 1, evolves through q versions under range operations that assign a constant, negate a range, or clamp a range to zero from below. Each query names a cell and asks for the maximum sum of a non-empty contiguous block of that cell's values over all earlier versions; queries are encoded with the previous answer, forcing online processing.
